_comment: Real Yon run, regression/book/jp/12_xtower_dial (toolchain/yonc) + 08_xtower_surface (widths). XTower is the dial of equality: same_branch(a,b,level) asks 'same?' at a grain you turn, Co0 (all one) -> N -> M24 (XRelSet's classes) -> id (XSet's individuals). The mutant 2361 is the SAME as 1445 at the coarse end (Co0, N) and DIFFERENT once the grain is fine (M24, id): same_branch = 1,1,0,0. The blind spot is the LEVEL, not the structure. Orbit labels are build-unstable; same_branch (the partition) is stable. xtower_class(1445) and the widths refine as you turn.
